# Packages that apt pulls into the closure but that are never linked against
# and never bundled. They are dropped after download to keep the repository
# small. Shell glob patterns, matched against the package name.

# Mesa's GPU drivers and their LLVM backend. The AppImage must use the GPU
# driver of the device (SteamOS), so these are only dead weight here.
libllvm*
mesa-libgallium
mesa-vulkan-drivers
mesa-va-drivers
mesa-vdpau-drivers
libgl1-mesa-dri
# SMT solver used only by libLLVM (excluded above).
libz3-*
